_doc: One entry per scene: narration (spoken) and caption (on screen). {LIVE_OR_SIM} and {EVAL_*} are filled by tts.py from the run's facts; nothing else is templated.

s01_hook.caption: PactPay: agreements that pay out exactly as written
s01_hook.narration: Freelance teams still get paid on trust, and split the money by hand. PactPay turns the agreement into a locked payment policy, and PayPal processes every payment step. Its AI can hold money back. It can never release it.

s02_agreement.caption: 1 · Describe the agreement in plain words
s02_agreement.narration: Start with the agreement in plain words: the budget, the shares, the deliverables.

s03_drafted.caption: AI drafts the policy, checked word-for-word against the chat
s03_drafted.narration: A local model drafts the policy in integer cents and exact shares. Every requirement must quote the chat word for word, and anything the draft invents, leaves out, or cannot test is flagged for a person to review.

s04_pact.caption: 2 · A policy both parties can read: tests, payees, cents
s04_pact.narration: Here is a five hundred dollar milestone: four requirements with executable tests, and a seventy thirty split.

s05_lock.caption: Both approve one SHA-256 — any edit invalidates both approvals
s05_lock.narration: Both parties approve one SHA-256 of these terms. Any edit voids both approvals, and once locked, nothing can change.

s06_fund.caption: 3 · PayPal Orders v2 · intent AUTHORIZE — {LIVE_OR_SIM}
s06_fund.narration: The client funds it with a PayPal authorization: the money is held, not moved. PactPay accepts the hold only after reading PayPal's own record. {FUND_NOTE}

s06b_held.caption: Hold verified from PayPal's own order record

s07_flawed.caption: 4 · The freelancer delivers a first draft
s07_flawed.narration: A first draft arrives. The agreed tests run in a sandbox, then an AI reviewer reads the code.

s08_flawed_result.caption: Tests fail C3 · AI cites the exact line · 75% recommended
s08_flawed_result.narration: One requirement fails. The AI cites the exact lines, and PactPay verifies every quote. Seventy five percent is only a recommendation.

s09_attack.caption: An attacker's version: instructions hidden for the AI
s09_attack.narration: Now an attack: hidden instructions telling the AI to pass everything.

s10_attack_result.caption: Injection flagged · tests fail · $0 recommended
s10_attack_result.narration: Flagged. The tests fail. Zero is recommended. The AI can hold a payment back, but never push one through.

s12_fixed_result.caption: All tests pass · only verified AI quotes count · 100%
s12_fixed_result.narration: Every test passes. An AI verdict counts only with a verified quote.

s13_release.caption: 5 · A person releases — PayPal captures, then pays out
s13_release.narration: A person releases. PayPal captures once, and one Payouts batch splits what PayPal actually received, to the cent.

s14_paid.caption: Each payee's status is what PayPal reports
s14_paid.narration: Each payee's status is exactly what PayPal reports. {PAYOUT_NOTE}

s15_duplicate.caption: A second release is refused
s15_duplicate.narration: A second release is refused by PactPay. PayPal's record shows one capture and one payout.

s16_evidence.caption: 6 · Evidence: hash-chained log + every PayPal call
s16_evidence.narration: Everything lands on a hash-chained record, with every PayPal call and its debug id.

s17_close.caption: {EVAL_CAPTION}
s17_close.narration: {EVAL_NARRATION} PactPay. AI that reads the work, people who decide, and PayPal records that prove it.
